verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שִׁמְר֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וַעֲשׂ֣וּ צְדָקָ֑ה כִּֽי־ קְרוֹבָ֤ה יְשֽׁוּעָתִי֙ לָב֔וֹא וְצִדְקָתִ֖י לְהִגָּלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh šim·rū miš·pāṭ wa·‘ă·śū ṣə·ḏā·qāh kî- qə·rō·w·ḇāh yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî lā·ḇō·w wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî lə·hig·gā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Maintain justice and do what is right for My salvation is coming soon and My righteousness will be revealed
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Guardai o juízo e fazei justiça, pois a minha salvação está prestes a vir, e a minha justiça, prestes a se manifestar.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י אֱנוֹשׁ֙ יַעֲשֶׂה־ זֹּ֔את וּבֶן־ אָדָ֖ם יַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑הּ שֹׁמֵ֤ר שַׁבָּת֙ מֵֽחַלְּל֔וֹ וְשֹׁמֵ֥ר יָד֖וֹ מֵעֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל־ רָֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ĕ·nō·wōš ya·‘ă·śeh- zōṯ ū·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ya·ḥă·zîq bāh šō·mêr šab·bāṯ mê·ḥal·lə·lōw wə·šō·mêr yā·ḏōw mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ kāl- rā‘
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who does this and the son of man who holds it fast who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil
verses.literalPt: Feliz é o homem que faz isso, e o filho do homem que lança mão disso, que guarda o sábado para não o profanar e guarda as suas mãos para não praticar mal algum.

verses.original: וְאַל־ יֹאמַ֣ר בֶּן־ הַנֵּכָ֗ר הַנִּלְוָ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַבְדֵּ֧ל יַבְדִּילַ֛נִי יְהוָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל עַמּ֑וֹ וְאַל־ יֹאמַר֙ הַסָּרִ֔יס הֵ֥ן אֲנִ֖י עֵ֥ץ יָבֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- yō·mar ben- han·nê·ḵār han·nil·wāh ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr haḇ·dêl yaḇ·dî·la·nî Yah·weh mê·‘al ‘am·mōw wə·’al- yō·mar has·sā·rîs hên ’ă·nî ‘êṣ yā·ḇêš
verses.literal: Let no foreigner . . . who has joined himself to the LORD say The LORD will utterly exclude me . . . from His people And let the eunuch not say I am but a dry tree
verses.literalPt: Não diga o estrangeiro que se uniu a Jeová: Certamente, Jeová me separará do seu povo; não diga o eunuco: Eis que sou uma árvore seca.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַסָּֽרִיסִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְרוּ֙ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֔י וּבָֽחֲר֖וּ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפָ֑צְתִּי וּמַחֲזִיקִ֖ים בִּבְרִיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh las·sā·rî·sîm ’ă·šer yiš·mə·rū ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay ū·ḇā·ḥă·rū ba·’ă·šer ḥā·p̄ā·ṣə·tî ū·ma·ḥă·zî·qîm biḇ·rî·ṯî
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths who choose what pleases Me and hold fast to My covenant
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz Jeová a respeito dos eunucos que guardam os seus sábados, e escolhem as coisas em que me agrado, e abraçam a minha aliança:

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֜ם בְּבֵיתִ֤י וּבְחֽוֹמֹתַי֙ יָ֣ד וָשֵׁ֔ם ט֖וֹב מִבָּנִ֣ים וּמִבָּנ֑וֹת שֵׁ֤ם עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּן־ ל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem bə·ḇê·ṯî ū·ḇə·ḥō·w·mō·ṯay yāḏ wā·šêm ṭō·wḇ mib·bā·nîm ū·mib·bā·nō·wṯ šêm ‘ō·w·lām ’et·ten- lōw ’ă·šer lō yik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: I will give them in My house and within My walls a memorial and a name better than that of sons and daughters I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off
verses.literalPt: Dar-lhes-ei, na minha casa e dentro dos meus muros, um memorial e um nome melhor do que o de filhos e filhas; dar-lhes-ei um nome sempiterno, que não se apagará.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י הַנֵּכָ֗ר הַנִּלְוִ֤ים עַל־ יְהוָה֙ לְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וּֽלְאַהֲבָה֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לִהְי֥וֹת ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִ֑ים כָּל־ שֹׁמֵ֤ר שַׁבָּת֙ מֵֽחַלְּל֔וֹ וּמַחֲזִיקִ֖ים בִּבְרִיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê han·nê·ḵār han·nil·wîm ‘al- Yah·weh lə·šā·rə·ṯōw ū·lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh lih·yō·wṯ lōw la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm kāl- šō·mêr šab·bāṯ mê·ḥal·lə·lōw ū·ma·ḥă·zî·qîm biḇ·rî·ṯî
verses.literal: And the foreigners . . . who join themselves to the LORD to minister to Him to love the name of the LORD and to be His servants all who keep the Sabbath without profaning it and who hold fast to My covenant
verses.literalPt: Também os estrangeiros que se unem a Jeová, para o servirem, e amarem o nome de Jeová, a fim de que lhe sejam servos, sim, todos os que guardam o sábado, para que não o profanem, e abraçam a minha aliança;

verses.original: וַהֲבִיאוֹתִ֞ים אֶל־ הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֗י וְשִׂמַּחְתִּים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית תְּפִלָּתִ֔י עוֹלֹתֵיהֶ֧ם וְזִבְחֵיהֶ֛ם לְרָצ֖וֹן עַֽל־ מִזְבְּחִ֑י כִּ֣י בֵיתִ֔י בֵּית־ תְּפִלָּ֥ה יִקָּרֵ֖א לְכָל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḇî·’ō·w·ṯîm ’el- har qāḏ·šî wə·śim·maḥ·tîm bə·ḇêṯ tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ‘ō·w·lō·ṯê·hem wə·ziḇ·ḥê·hem lə·rā·ṣō·wn ‘al- miz·bə·ḥî kî ḇê·ṯî bêṯ- tə·p̄il·lāh yiq·qā·rê lə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: I will bring them to My holy mountain and make them joyful in My house of prayer Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on My altar for My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations
verses.literalPt: a estes, os levarei ao meu santo monte e os alegrarei na minha casa de oração. Os seus holocaustos e os seus sacrifícios serão aceitos sobre o meu altar, porque a minha casa será chamada Casa de Oração para todos os povos.

verses.original: נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה מְקַבֵּ֖ץ נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֛וֹד אֲקַבֵּ֥ץ עָלָ֖יו לְנִקְבָּצָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh mə·qab·bêṣ niḏ·ḥê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·wḏ ’ă·qab·bêṣ ‘ā·lāw lə·niq·bā·ṣāw
verses.literal: Thus declares the Lord GOD who gathers the dispersed of Israel I will gather to them still others besides those already gathered
verses.literalPt: O Senhor Jeová, que congrega os dispersos de Israel, diz: Ainda outros congregarei a ele, além dos seus que se acham congregados.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י אֵתָ֕יוּ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל כָּל־ חַיְת֖וֹ בַּיָּֽעַר׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōl ḥay·ṯōw śā·ḏāy ’ê·ṯā·yū le·’ĕ·ḵōl kāl- ḥay·ṯōw bay·yā·‘ar
verses.literal: Come all you beasts of the field eat greedily all you beasts of the forest
verses.literalPt: Vós, todos os animais do campo, todos os animais do bosque, vinde a devorar.

verses.original: צָפוּ עִוְרִ֤ים כֻּלָּם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ כֻּלָּם֙ כְּלָבִ֣ים אִלְּמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לִנְבֹּ֑חַ הֹזִים֙ שֹֽׁכְבִ֔ים אֹהֲבֵ֖י לָנֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣå̄·p̄ū ‘iw·rîm kul·lām lō yā·ḏā·‘ū kul·lām kə·lā·ḇîm ’il·lə·mîm lō yū·ḵə·lū lin·bō·aḥ hō·zîm šō·ḵə·ḇîm ’ō·hă·ḇê lā·nūm
verses.literal: Israel’s watchmen are blind they are all oblivious . . . they are all mute dogs they cannot . . . bark they are dreamers lying around loving to slumber
verses.literalPt: Os seus vigias são cegos, todos eles são sem entendimento; todos são cães mudos que não podem ladrar; sonham, deitam-se, gostam de dormir.

verses.original: וְהַכְּלָבִ֣ים עַזֵּי־ נֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ שָׂבְעָ֔ה וְהֵ֣מָּה רֹעִ֔ים לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ הָבִ֑ין כֻּלָּם֙ לְדַרְכָּ֣ם פָּנ֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְבִצְע֖וֹ מִקָּצֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kə·lā·ḇîm ‘az·zê- ne·p̄eš lō yā·ḏə·‘ū śā·ḇə·‘āh wə·hêm·māh rō·‘îm lō yā·ḏə·‘ū hā·ḇîn kul·lām lə·ḏar·kām pā·nū ’îš lə·ḇiṣ·‘ōw miq·qā·ṣê·hū
verses.literal: Like ravenous dogs . . . . . . they are never satisfied . . . They are shepherds with no discernment they all turn to their own way each one seeking his own gain
verses.literalPt: Os cães são vorazes, nunca podem fartar-se; e estes são pastores que não podem entender; todos eles declinaram para o seu caminho, cada um para a sua ganância, todos sem exceção.

verses.original: אֵתָ֥יוּ אֶקְחָה־ יַ֖יִן וְנִסְבְּאָ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְהָיָ֤ה כָזֶה֙ י֣וֹם מָחָ֔ר גָּד֖וֹל יֶ֥תֶר מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ṯā·yū ’eq·ḥāh- ya·yin wə·nis·bə·’āh šê·ḵār wə·hā·yāh ḵā·zeh yō·wm mā·ḥār gā·ḏō·wl ye·ṯer mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Come let me get the wine let us imbibe the strong drink and tomorrow will be like today . . . only far . . . better
verses.literalPt: Vinde, trarei vinho, e nos encheremos de bebida forte; amanhã será como hoje, dia desmesuradamente grande.
